sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 回想当年我在黑胶唱片时代在夜总会当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都要带着300件你最珍爱的宝贝去上班，你把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成了一个美丽的、拥有50年历史的文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: In Pakistan, a once-in-a-generation flood has submerged a third of the country, marooned entire villages, and killed a staggering 1,500 people.
sentences.zh: 在巴基斯坦，一场难得一见的特大洪水淹没了全国三分之一的土地，使整个村庄成为孤岛，并夺去了惊人的1500人的生命。

sentences.en: My colleague, Christina Goldbaum, was there and documented what happens when the floodwaters refuse to recede.
sentences.zh: 我的同事克里斯蒂娜·戈德鲍姆亲历了那里，并记录了当洪水迟迟不退时会发生什么。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 5th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月5日，星期三。

sentences.en: Christina, we are talking to you from Karachi, one of the largest cities in Pakistan, and you have been reporting from Pakistan for weeks now on the floods there.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜，我们正在卡拉奇与你通话，这是巴基斯坦最大的城市之一，而你已经在巴基斯坦报道那里的洪水好几个星期了。

sentences.en: And at this point, we are very deep into the aftermath of this natural disaster, but I want to start at the beginning with the flooding itself.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们正处于这场自然灾害的严重善后阶段，但我想从最初的洪水本身开始讲起。

sentences.en: So can you roll back the clock a little bit and take us to the start?
sentences.zh: 所以你能把时间倒回一点，带我们回到一切开始的时候吗？

sentences.en: So at the beginning of June, the usual Monseen season started in Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 所以在6月初，巴基斯坦迎来了常规的季风季节。

sentences.en: And this is the three- or four-month-long period where the country gets very heavy rains.
sentences.zh: 这是一个持续三到四个月的时期，期间全国降雨量非常大。

sentences.en: You know, the season is always tough.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这个季节总是很难熬。

sentences.en: There's always some damage, some electricity lines go down, some homes get destroyed.
sentences.zh: 总会有一些破坏，一些电线被毁，一些房屋被摧毁。

sentences.en: And, you know, back in 2010, there were really intense rains that caused a lot of destruction and loss of life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，早在2010年，就曾有过非常猛烈的降雨，造成了巨大的破坏和生命损失。

sentences.en: But within a few weeks this year of the monsoon season, it became very clear that the rains and the floods that we were seeing were unlike anything the country
sentences.zh: 但今年在季风季节开始后的几周内，人们变得非常清楚，我们所看到的降雨和洪水是这个国家

sentences.en: had experienced in a very long time.
sentences.zh: 在很长一段时间内从未经历过的。

sentences.en: The rains just didn't stop.
sentences.zh: 雨就是不停。

sentences.en: And they were a lot heavier than usual.
sentences.zh: 而且比平时大得多。

sentences.en: You know, week after week, they were breaking records
sentences.zh: 你知道，一周又一周，它们不断打破纪录

sentences.en: and causing these massive floods.
sentences.zh: 并引发了这些巨大的洪水。

sentences.en: You know, we were seeing videos of homes being washed away,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们看到房屋被冲走的视频，

sentences.en: of flood water crashing through bridges.
sentences.zh: 洪水冲垮桥梁的视频。

sentences.en: There was this five-star luxury hotel that got swept away in seconds from flood water.
sentences.zh: 有一家五星级豪华酒店在几秒钟内就被洪水卷走了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Just gone.
sentences.zh: 就这样没了。

sentences.en: Just gone.
sentences.zh: 就这样没了。

sentences.en: And by early September,
sentences.zh: 到9月初，

sentences.en: Pakistani officials were saying that a third of the country was underwater.
sentences.zh: 巴基斯坦官员称全国三分之一的土地都被水淹了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that's an area around the same size as all of Britain.
sentences.zh: 所以这片区域大约和整个英国一样大。

sentences.en: And it was suddenly submerged.
sentences.zh: 而且它突然被淹没了。

sentences.en: Nearly a thousand have been killed so far, hundreds of them children.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止已有近千人丧生，其中数百人是儿童。

sentences.en: 33 million are affected.
sentences.zh: 3300万人受到影响。

sentences.en: That's one in every seven Pakistanis.
sentences.zh: 相当于每七个巴基斯坦人中就有一个。

sentences.en: Prompting a government minister to call it a humanitarian disaster of epic proportions.
sentences.zh: 这促使一名政府部长称其为史诗级的人道主义灾难。

sentences.en: Pakistan's prime minister has repeatedly visited hard-hit areas this flooding season, insisting his administration is doing all it can.
sentences.zh: 巴基斯坦总理在这个洪水季节多次访问受灾严重的地区，坚信他的政府正在尽其所能。

sentences.en: So in early September, when I got a visa to finally go to Pakistan, I hopped on a plane there.
sentences.zh: 所以在9月初，当我终于拿到去巴基斯坦的签证时，我便跳上了飞往那里的飞机。

sentences.en: And I spent the last couple of weeks traveling around Sin province in the south, one of the worst-hit areas of the country.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几个星期里，我一直在南部信德省四处奔波，这里是该国受灾最严重的地区之一。

sentences.en: And it was like nothing I had ever seen before.
sentences.zh: 这简直是我从未见过的景象。

sentences.en: And what did you see?
sentences.zh: 你都看到了什么？

sentences.en: So I arrived in Karachi, this big port city in the south, and our plan was to first go to a place called Dadu.
sentences.zh: 我到达了南部的这座大型港口城市卡拉奇，我们的计划是先去一个叫达杜的地方。

sentences.en: It was one of the worst-hit areas by the flood.
sentences.zh: 那是受洪水影响最严重的地区之一。

sentences.en: And so we got into our big four-wheel drive car, and it's nighttime, and we start driving up to the district along this highway.
sentences.zh: 于是我们上了我们的大型四驱车，当时是夜里，我们开始沿着这条高速公路向该地区开去。

sentences.en: And we're on this highway, and we keep passing these trucks that have little speedboats in the back of them.
sentences.zh: 我们在高速公路上，不断超越那些后面载着小型快艇的卡车。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's a full moon outside, and at one point, I look out the window, and I can kind of see this, like, black, shimmering water.
sentences.zh: 你知道，外面是满月，有那么一刻，我看着窗外，能隐约看到这种黑色的、波光粼粼的水面。

sentences.en: And I asked my colleague,
sentences.zh: 我问我的同事，

sentences.en: Zia, who's a reporter based in Karachi, who was with us, are we passing a lake?
sentences.zh: 齐亚，他是常驻卡拉奇的记者，和我们同行，我们是在经过一个湖吗？

sentences.en: What is this?
sentences.zh: 这是什么？

sentences.en: And he said, no, no, that's the floodwater.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，不，那是洪水。

sentences.en: And keep in mind, we were still four or five hours from the worst-hit areas.
sentences.zh: 记住，我们距离受灾最严重的地区还有四到五个小时的车程。

sentences.en: And the next morning, we arrived in Dadu.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我们到达了达杜。

sentences.en: So it's around 9.30.
sentences.zh: 大约是9点半。

sentences.en: We just got to Dadu District.
sentences.zh: 我们刚到达杜区。

sentences.en: It's one of the worst-hit in Sindh.
sentences.zh: 这是信德省受灾最严重的地区之一。

sentences.en: And we went to what used to be a bus station, where people were going between the city and their farmland or villages.
sentences.zh: 我们去了曾经是汽车站的地方，人们以前在那里往返于城市和农田或村庄之间。

sentences.en: And the bus station had basically turned into a dock.
sentences.zh: 而这个汽车站基本上已经变成了一个码头。

sentences.en: And everything around us is just water.
sentences.zh: 我们周围的一切都只是水。

sentences.en: It looks like we're at the beginning of a huge lake.
sentences.zh: 看起来我们就像在一个巨大湖泊的边缘。

sentences.en: There's a ton of people around.
sentences.zh: 周围有大量的人。

sentences.en: A lot of these kind of wooden canoes that people are taking out to get to their land if it's still above water, but stranded.
sentences.zh: 其中许多人乘坐这种木制独木舟，如果他们的土地还在水面之上但被困住了，他们就会坐船过去。

sentences.en: So boats are now public transportation at a bus station.
sentences.zh: 所以现在船成了汽车站的公共交通工具。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Some people are coming in from their homes, and it looks like they're carrying
sentences.zh: 有些人从他们的家园赶来，看起来他们带着

sentences.en: suitcases,
sentences.zh: 手提箱，

sentences.en: other bags
sentences.zh: 其他装着他们东西的

sentences.en: with their stuff.
sentences.zh: 包。

sentences.en: And people were there, these big crowds, and they were moving huge bags of wheat and of rice to their villages.
sentences.zh: 人们聚集在那里，黑压压的一片，他们把成大袋的小麦和大米搬回村庄。

sentences.en: Some people were moving their entire herds of goats or of cows.
sentences.zh: 有些人正在转移他们整群的山羊或奶牛。

sentences.en: There were a bunch of guys with a...
sentences.zh: 有一群人在……

sentences.en: There's a big brown cow in one of these boats, and they're trying to push him off the boat to get him onto some dry land.
sentences.zh: 其中一只船上有一头棕色的大牛，他们正试图把它推下船，好让它上岸到干燥的土地上。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So we took a boat out to see some of that area.
sentences.zh: 所以我们坐船去看了看那片区域。

sentences.en: Keep loading.
sentences.zh: 继续装载。

sentences.en: And truly, what was farmland was now just this giant lake.
sentences.zh: 真的，曾经的农田现在只剩下一个巨大的湖泊。

sentences.en: And popping out of the water, we saw the second story of schools that were submerged.
sentences.zh: 从水里探出头来的是被淹没的学校的二层。

sentences.en: This is a school.
sentences.zh: 这是一所学校。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: We saw villages that had basically become islands because they were completely surrounded.
sentences.zh: 我们看到一些村庄基本上变成了孤岛，因为它们被完全包围了。

sentences.en: Homes had either partially collapsed or were completely underwater.
sentences.zh: 房屋部分倒塌或完全沉入水中。

sentences.en: We saw these blue notebooks from a school that were just floating by the window, you know, a random flip-flop here and there.
sentences.zh: 我们看到学校的蓝色笔记本从窗户漂过，你知道，还有零星的人字拖。

sentences.en: So this area has been physically redrawn by water for what will probably be a very long time.
sentences.zh: 所以这个地区的物理地貌已经被水重新勾勒了，而且很可能会持续很长时间。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There are entire communities that will either be living on islands or displaced for months or even years to come.
sentences.zh: 整个社区要么住在孤岛上，要么将在未来数月甚至数年内流离失所。

sentences.en: But while I was in Dadu, I heard about another district, a farming area called Nawabshah, which is a couple of hours away.
sentences.zh: 但当我在达杜时，我听说另一个区，一个名为纳瓦布沙阿的农业区，距离这里几个小时的车程。

sentences.en: And there, the water had begun to recede just a bit.
sentences.zh: 在那里，水已经开始稍微退去了。

sentences.en: All right, so it's around
sentences.zh: 好的，现在大约是
上午10点。

sentences.en: We just arrived in Nawabshah district.
sentences.zh: 我们刚到纳瓦布沙阿区。

sentences.en: It's a big cotton and wheat growing area.
sentences.zh: 这是一个主要的棉花和小麦种植区。

sentences.en: We're going to try to talk to some farmers here.
sentences.zh: 我们要试着和这里的几个农民聊聊。

sentences.en: And as we're going along this long, bumpy road, you could see the kind of shriveled stalks of cotton popping up from the water.
sentences.zh: 当我们沿着这条长而颠簸的道路前进时，你可以看到水面上露出的枯萎的棉花秆。

sentences.en: It looks like the harvest is about like half submerged in water.
sentences.zh: 看起来收成大约有一半被淹在水里。

sentences.en: And we're walking down this little path to where these small mudbrick homes are to talk to some of the farmers there.
sentences.zh: 我们沿着这条小路走到这些小泥砖房所在的地方，去和那里的农民谈谈。

sentences.en: And we meet this one guy,
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了这个人，

sentences.en: Miraj.
sentences.zh: 米拉吉。

sentences.en: And he starts telling us about when the rains came to their village a couple of weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 他开始向我们讲述几周前雨水降临他们村庄时的情景。

sentences.en: He didn't remember the date, but he said suddenly in the night rain started.
sentences.zh: 他不记得具体日期了，但他说是突然在夜里下起了雨。

sentences.en: So suddenly in the night it started to rain.
sentences.zh: 所以突然在夜里开始下雨。

sentences.en: Was it very heavy rain?
sentences.zh: 雨下得很大吗？

sentences.en: He said I didn't see such life in my life.
sentences.zh: 他说我一生中都没见过这样的生命（景象）。

sentences.en: It's very heavy.
sentences.zh: 雨非常大。

sentences.en: 56 hours, it was continuous.
sentences.zh: 连续下了56个小时。

sentences.en: And how he was inside his home and it was in the middle of the night and he could hear this really heavy rain just pounding down.
sentences.zh: 他讲述了他当时如何在屋里，那是半夜，他能听到这场大雨倾盆而下。

sentences.en: He's saying that where we're sitting right now, the water, when it was really heavily raining for that
sentences.zh: 他说，就在我们现在坐的地方，当时雨下得非常大，持续了

sentences.en: 56 hours, it was up to his waiSt.
sentences.zh: 56个小时，水一直涨到了他的腰部。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好的，好的。

sentences.en: And so at first they came out here into the yard because they were afraid of the house collapsing.
sentences.zh: 所以起初他们来到院子里，因为他们害怕房子倒塌。

sentences.en: And as they were, they stayed there for all 56 hours, despite the raining, just they were exposed in the rain.
sentences.zh: 当他们这么做时，他们在雨中待了整整56个小时，尽管下着雨，他们就这样暴露在雨中。

sentences.en: And every time that one of the walls of one of their houses collapsed, they could hear, like, it felt like an explosion that they could hear.
sentences.zh: 每当他们房子的其中一面墙倒塌时，他们都能听到声音，感觉就像爆炸一样。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And he watched for hours as the water just started rising and rising.
sentences.zh: 他看着水一点点上涨，足足看了几个小时。

sentences.en: You know, he was going to his field every few hours.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他每隔几个小时就会去他的田里。

sentences.en: In front of my eyes, I was seeing the water level was increasing
sentences.zh: 就在我眼前，我看着水位在上涨

sentences.en: He's saying that when he went there in front of his eyes, he saw his crops being destroyed.
sentences.zh: 他说当他走到那里时，他亲眼看到他的庄稼被毁了。

sentences.en: And watching as the water level just rose until it completely covered what would have been his entire fall harveSt.
sentences.zh: 看着水位不断上升，直到完全淹没了本该是他整个秋季的收成。

sentences.en: Well, explain that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，解释一下。

sentences.en: How does farming work in this region?
sentences.zh: 这个地区的农业是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: So in this part of
sentences.zh: 所以在巴基斯坦的这个地方，

sentences.en: Pakistan, farmers usually farm two crops.
sentences.zh: 农民通常种植两种作物。

sentences.en: Every fall, they harvest cotton or rice, and they sell that harvest, and that's their big payday for the year.
sentences.zh: 每年秋天，他们收获棉花或水稻，然后出售这些收成，这是他们一年中最大的一笔收入。

sentences.en: And then, around late October or
sentences.zh: 然后，在10月下旬或

sentences.en: November, they start planting wheat, and that's their main source of food.
sentences.zh: 11月左右，他们开始种植小麦，这是他们主要的食物来源。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And so, as
sentences.zh: 所以，当

sentences.en: Miraj was watching the water rise up and cover his cotton harvest, basically, what he was seeing was one of those paydays suddenly gone.
sentences.zh: 米拉吉看着水漫上来并淹没他的棉花收成时，基本上，他看到的是他的一笔收入突然化为乌有。

sentences.en: That harvest was ruined.
sentences.zh: 那季收成毁了。

sentences.en: And he was beginning to worry that in a couple of weeks, in late
sentences.zh: 他开始担心，再过几周，到了10月下旬

sentences.en: October, when he was meant to plant the wheat, the water would still be there.
sentences.zh: 他本该种小麦的时候，水依然会退不去。

sentences.en: And that wouldn't just be one harvest that's gone, but his harvest next year of wheat, too.
sentences.zh: 那不仅意味着失去了一季收成，连他明年小麦的收成也会泡汤。

sentences.en: What is he feeling?
sentences.zh: 他现在是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Is he worried?
sentences.zh: 他很担心吗？

sentences.en: Like, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我说不上来。

sentences.en: So he is now at risk of losing both his cotton, which is basically his currency, his money, and his wheat, which is his food, his diet.
sentences.zh: 所以他现在面临着失去棉花——这基本上是他的货币、金钱——以及小麦——这是他的食物、日常饮食——的双重风险。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as I'm sitting there talking to him,
sentences.zh: 正当我坐在那里和他交谈时，

sentences.en: there is this other woman nearby, Padma, who's around 50 years old.
sentences.zh: 附近还有另一位妇女，帕德玛，大约50岁左右。

sentences.en: And she came over and tapped me on the shoulder.
sentences.zh: 她走过来拍了拍我的肩膀。

sentences.en: Because she wanted to tell me about her harvest, too, that had been underwater with the floods.
sentences.zh: 因为她也想告诉我关于她的收成，那些收成也在洪水中被淹了。

sentences.en: And so I asked to go see her fields to see what they looked like now a couple of weeks after the worst of the rains came.
sentences.zh: 所以我要求去看看她的田地，看看在最严重的暴雨过去几周后，它们现在是什么样子。

sentences.en: So we're driving down the road in Noab Shah.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正开车行驶在纳瓦布沙阿的路上。

sentences.en: And on either side of the road, there's just these fields of what was cotton and water that probably goes up to, like, people's waists, people's ankles.
sentences.zh: 在道路的两侧，全都是曾经是棉花地、现在积水大概齐腰深或齐脚踝深的田地。

sentences.en: You know, the tops of the cotton trees are kind of coming out of the water, they look really brown, kind of dead.
sentences.zh: 你知道，棉花树的顶端从水里露出来，它们看起来呈褐色，已经死掉了。

sentences.en: You know, a massive disaster happens and they have the infrastructure and the funding and the local partners to just jump into action.

sentences.en: But this year, because there is so much stagnant water across such a large part of the country and it's not going anywhere, the mosquitoes are breeding very quickly

sentences.en: And so, already in hospitals, you're seeing this massive influx of people, especially kids, who are sick with malaria and dengue and other waterborne diseases from the floods.

sentences.zh: 我们在达鲁遇到的人之一告诉我，这对于那些变成孤岛、乘船需要数小时才能到达的村庄来说尤其是一个问题。

sentences.en: So we got back onto the boat and we went out to go talk to her.
